description: This file defines internal structures, classes, and functions for managing command-line flags in the Abseil C++ library, including flag storage, parsing, and reflection mechanisms.

classes.name: Flag
classes.description: Template class representing a command-line flag with reflection capabilities.

classes.name: FlagImpl
classes.description: Internal class encapsulating flag data and operations, independent of value type.

classes.name: FlagState
classes.description: Class managing the state of a flag for saving and restoring.

classes.name: FlagValue
classes.description: Template struct for storing flag values with different storage strategies.

classes.name: FlagCallback
classes.description: Struct representing a callback function for flag updates.

methods.name: Flag::Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the flag, parsing if necessary.

methods.name: Flag::Set
methods.description: Sets the flag to a new value.

methods.name: FlagImpl::Read
methods.description: Reads the flag value into a destination buffer.

methods.name: FlagImpl::Write
methods.description: Writes a new value to the flag.

methods.name: FlagOps
methods.description: Performs operations like allocation, deallocation, parsing, and copying for flag values.
